description: Source stall, source error, and source panic scenarios — bounded shutdown with zeroized candidates and typed unavailable state.

source_stall.setup: MockSource with empty frame list → next_frame returns Ok(None) immediately
source_stall.notes: Worker emits Exhausted and enters waiting state. Does not auto-commit. Accepts subsequent commands (Stop, Commit, Cancel, Shutdown). shutdown_and_join sends Shutdown → capture.cancel() → thread exits.

source_error.notes: Worker catches the pump error, calls capture.cancel() (zeroizes reservoir, stops capture source), emits Error event, and exits the loop. The thread terminates cleanly.

source_panic.notes: If pump() panics, catch_unwind catches it, worker calls capture.cancel() and emits Error. The thread does not propagate the panic to the main thread.

common_assertions.typed_unavailable_state: WorkerEvent::Error(String) carries the error message; capture phase transitions to Cancelled
